name: Classic CRT
description: Neutral falloff around the edges, with darker corners.

name: Soft Corners
description: A subtle fade concentrated in the corners.

name: Deep CRT
description: Stronger shadow and a more visible oval.

name: Wide Tube
description: Preserves the center of wide displays and shades the top and bottom.

name: Portrait Tube
description: Brings the falloff inward along the left and right edges.

name: Blue Hour
description: Cool blue shadows with a broad transition.

name: Warm Film
description: Soft brown shading inspired by warm film prints.

name: Plum Shadow
description: Muted violet gathers in the corners.

name: Green Phosphor
description: Deep green edges around a clear center.

name: Silver Halo
description: A faint neutral glow lifts the edges.

name: Warm Halo

name: Rose Light
description: A gentle pink glow, mostly in the corners.

name: Mint Glow
